customer_acme: Hi team — after upgrading our SDK to v1.8.0 we're intermittently getting 400s from /v1/functions/invoke for the 'charge' tool. Error in response: "invalid_arguments_shape: expected items=array<object>, got string". Happening for ~5% of requests. Sample curl below (sensitive fields redacted):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/functions/invoke \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACTED' \n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \n  -d '{"name":"charge","arguments":{"order_id":"ORD-123","items":"[{\"sku\":\"A1\",\"qty\":1}]","amount":1200}}'
```
Please advise — this is causing retry storms and we've seen duplicate charges. trace_id=trc_9ab3f

maria_support: Thanks — sorry you're hitting this. Can you confirm the SDK package name + exact version and whether you set any custom encoder flags? Also paste the full raw request body (redact tokens). We'll triage.

customer_acme: SDK is @redwood/sdk v1.8.0. We did enable compact_payload=true in our config to reduce bytes over mobile. Full raw body (redacted):
```json
{"name":"charge","arguments":{"order_id":"ORD-123","items":"[{\"sku\":\"A1\",\"qty\":1}]","amount":1200},"idempotency_key":"user-req-55"}
```
We can reproduce locally with that curl.

alex_sre: I'm seeing runtime logs for trace trc_9ab3f showing the validator failing with: "schema_mismatch: path arguments.items type string != expected array". Example runtime log snippet:
```
2026-03-11T14:12:03Z runtime[req=trc_9ab3f] ERROR validate_tool_args charge: expected array at arguments.items, got string
```
It looks like requests are arriving with items as a JSON string rather than an array.

dev_ryan: Heads-up: we shipped a change in sdk v1.8.0 that toggles compact encoding; for nested arrays/objects we accidentally stringify the payload when compact_payload=true to shave bytes. This wasn't intended for structured tool args (JSON mode). We have a patch that prevents stringifying nested args in strict structured output paths.

dev_ryan: Short-term mitigation: set compact_payload=false in your SDK config or remove that flag. That will stop items being stringified. Example: 
```js
import Redwood from '@redwood/sdk';
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY, compact_payload: false });
```
We will push 1.8.2 with the fix in ~2h. If you need an immediate hotfix on our side we can also temporarily accept stringified arrays for this tool via a lenient validator (we'd need approval because of schema-safety).

maria_support: Two operational notes: 1) For billing safety, please set unique idempotency keys and halt client-side retries until you confirm. 2) We'll open an internal incident to coordinate the patch and add a quick rollout plan. Do you want us to enable the lenient validator for your org while you roll the SDK change?

customer_acme: We'll flip compact_payload=false and redeploy in 30 minutes. Please DO NOT enable lenient validator for us unless absolutely needed. Also thanks for the idempotency reminder — we have keys, but retries were aggressive in our retry layer.

support-bot: Incident INC-2026-83 created: runtime/parser-strictjson-accept-stringified-arrays. POC assigned: dev_ryan. ETA patch release window: ~2 hours.

alex_sre: After you redeploy, please post a sample request_id from a failing call if it still occurs. We'll keep an eye on error rate and any billing anomalies.

customer_acme: Redeployed with compact_payload=false — testing now. I'll report back in 10m. Thanks. :thumbsup:
